faq.q: Does living near St John Paul II Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. St John Paul II Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the St John Paul II Academy home search find homes?

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near St John Paul II Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of St John Paul II Academy the median was 81 days on the market, closing at 93.2% of the list price, with 0% of sales above the list price for the 11 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to St John Paul II Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are White Rock Elementary (0.2 km north), Peace Arch Elementary (1.3 km east) and Earl Marriott Secondary (1.4 km north-east).

How the St John Paul II Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names St John Paul II Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of St John Paul II Academy

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of St John Paul II Academy in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is White Rock Elementary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Star of the Sea, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Earl Marriott Secondary (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Newbridge Academy (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Peace Arch Elementary (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: Earl Marriott Secondary (1.4 km north-east), Semiahmoo Secondary (1.7 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Earl Marriott Secondary, 1.4 km north-east of St John Paul II Academy.
